# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter sourcing and higher costs; lock in volume now for high‑risk analog parts.

## What changed
- Market supply risk holds at 71.8 (Elevated) and price trend at 82.0 (Rising) – no change week‑over‑week [source 1].  
- TSMC foundry loading up 56 % YoY through Oct 2026, pushing supply tighter [source 3].  
- Korea chip‑led exports jumped 100 % YoY in early Nov 2026, reinforcing demand pressure on both supply and price [source 4].  
- Semiconductor PPI up 9.1 % annualized over the last three months, adding upward pressure on component costs [source 1].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**, stock **27,081** units, no on‑order quantity disclosed.  
- Price **$5.56** per unit (qty 1) vs **$2.51** at 1 k pcs.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk **53.7** (Neutral), price trend **67.7** (Rising).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Hold course** – 59 % chance prices rise, but no strong timing signal [source featured_part].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Supply **71.8** (Elevated), Price **79.5** (Rising), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – Supply **70.1** (Elevated), Price **73.7** (Rising), High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – Supply **69.3** (Rising), Price **76.9** (Rising), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – Supply **67.0** (Rising), Price **76.6** (Rising), High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – Supply **66.3** (Rising), Price **79.6** (Rising), High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **SN65HVD230DR** – supply risk 82.4, driven by 26‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm.  
- **LM358DR** – supply risk 82.1, same 26‑week lead time pressure.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – supply risk 81.8, 26‑week lead time, price near target (‑0.9 %).  
- **TLV9002IDR** – supply risk 81.6, 26‑week lead time, price +26.3 % vs target.  
- **ADS1115IDGSR** – supply risk 81.5, 26‑week lead time, price +23.8 % vs target.

## Outlook
- Chip prices next 3 months: 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.17 % (80 % range –9.57 % to 13.91 %); model‑based edge tested.  
- Chip prices next 6 months: 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.34 % (range –8.79 % to 17.46 %); trend‑following baseline.  
- Fab utilization next 3 months: 63 % chance of tighter supply, expected +1.82 pts (range –1.71 to 5.36 pts).  
- Fab utilization next 6 months: 60 % chance of tighter supply, expected +3.64 pts (range –2.16 to 9.45 pts).  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock price for the top‑risk analog parts** (SN65HVD230DR, LM358DR, TPS62130RGTR) now; their 26‑week lead times will lock you into current pricing before any further hikes.  
2. **Ask suppliers for accelerated shipments or split‑lot deliveries** on the featured MOSFET (IPB017N10N5ATMA1) to reduce the 14‑week exposure while you hold course on price.  
3. **Leverage the high confidence in market trends** to negotiate volume rebates, citing the 59 % price‑rise probability and the tested model edge for 3‑month price forecasts.
